mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_codes (email, code_hash, display_name, attempts, expires_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{codeHash}, #{displayName}, #{attempts}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, code_hash, display_name, attempts, expires_at, consumed_at, created_at FROM login_codes WHERE email = #{email} AND consumed_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE login_codes SET consumed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE login_codes SET attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
